evals.prompt: QC this generated clip against shot SC02-SH030: assets/video/SC02-SH030_take01.mp4
evals.expected_output: Runs inspect_media.py, views frames, checks action/end state/identity/camera vs the shot record, gives a verdict with evidence.
expectations: inspect_media.py is run (or its absence reported as NOT-VERIFIABLE)
Findings cite frame times as evidence
The verdict is one of PASS/FIX/REDO/NOT-VERIFIABLE
Each FIX/REDO names an owner and a repair instruction

evals.prompt: Run a preflight check on the master production document before we start generating.
evals.expected_output: Runs the validator, checks coverage, MISSING markers, locks verbatim, durations; reports blockers first.
expectations: validate_production.py is run and the error count reported
MISSING markers in shot records are reported as blockers

evals.prompt: These keyframes look great to me, just approve them all.
evals.expected_output: Does not approve without inspection; inspects against specs and reports per-item verdicts.
expectations: The response does not approve items without inspecting them
Each keyframe gets its own verdict
Verdicts cite the spec they were checked against
